result.summary:
Added test/specs/ISS-0457.md and a new regression test in test/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs_test.exs proving splice_top_level_status/2 is now first-match-wins on a duplicate top-level `status` key. Replaced the stale 'deliberately left uncovered' ISS-0442-era comment block (previously at :722-742) with a pointer to the new coverage and to ISS-0457's resolution.

Fixture: two depth-1 `status` keys ('DONE' first, 'COMPLETE' second, both @autofix_map entries mapping to 'COMPLETED'), a nested result.status carrying a third legal value, built only from @schema_top_keys members (status/context/task/result) so it doesn't also trip the unrelated H3 non-schema-key check -- equivalent in shape to handoffs/WF03-ISS0457-20260904/diagnosis/dup-status-fixture.json, adapted for that reason. New test T-AUTOFIX-DUP-TOP-LEVEL-STATUS-FIRST-WINS (describe block 'ISS-0457 -- duplicate top-level status key, first-match-wins') asserts: (1) decoded top-level status == COMPLETED; (2) the raw rewritten text's FIRST occurrence span was rewritten to COMPLETED; (3) the raw rewritten text's SECOND occurrence span is still literally COMPLETE, untouched; (4) the whole rewritten file is byte-identical to a hand-computed `expected` string, proving the ONLY changed span anywhere in the file is the first occurrence's value token -- this is the strongest check and the one that actually discriminates first-wins from last-wins (a bare decode-based assertion alone cannot, since Jason.decode/1 only ever surfaces one occurrence regardless of which span the splice edited).

Fail-then-pass, both real outputs quoted (not asserted):

FAIL at pre-fix commit 373f5363 (main's tip immediately before this run's own ELIXIR-DEV Step 3 change, the ISS-0442 merge commit) -- reproduced in a disposable `git worktree add --detach ../letflow-wt-iss0457-faildemo 373f5363`, with `mix deps.get` run fresh in that worktree (no shared _build/deps) and the new test's describe block copied verbatim into that worktree's copy of test/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs_test.exs (inserted before its 'ISS-0440 -- run_autofix/1' describe block, matching this branch's own layout since that block predates this run). `MIX_ENV=test mix test test/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs_test.exs:908` there produced:
